sr.sum: Pocinkovani, aluminijumski, bakarni, crni toplo- i hladnovaljani, plastificirani po RAL karti i prohromski limovi.
desc: Osnovni materijal za svaki limarski posao. Držimo pocinkovane, aluminijumske, bakarne, crne toplo- i hladnovaljane, plastificirane po RAL karti i prohromske limove.
Pocinkovani lim svih formata, 0,4–2 mm, toplocinkovan 140, 200 i 275 g/m². Konfekcioniramo ga u svim oblicima za dalju doradu: sečenje iz kotura na potrebnu dužinu, sečenje table na meru, slitovanje.
specs: pocinkovani, alu, bakar, HVL, TVL, bojeni, inox
makaze do 13 mm, inox do 9 mm

en.t: Sheet metal in sheets and coils
en.sum: Galvanised, aluminium, copper, black hot- and cold-rolled, pre-painted (RAL) and stainless steel sheet.
desc: The basic material for any sheet-metal job. We stock galvanised, aluminium, copper, black hot- and cold-rolled, pre-painted (RAL colour chart) and stainless steel sheet.

Galvanised sheet in all formats, 0.4–2 mm, hot-dip galvanised 140, 200 and 275 g/m². We prepare it in any form for further processing: cutting from coil to the required length, cutting sheets to size, slitting.
specs: galvanised, aluminium, copper, CR, HR, pre-painted, stainless
guillotine up to 13 mm, stainless up to 9 mm

sr.sum: Kvadratne, pravougaone, colovne, precizne i grifovane cevi — sečene na meru.
desc: Šavne i precizne cevi i hladno oblikovani ZP profili. Sečemo ih na trakastim testerama na dužinu koju tražite, a šipkaste profile po potrebi i grifujemo.

en.sum: Square, rectangular, inch-size, precision and embossed tubes — cut to size.
desc: Welded and precision tubes and cold-formed ZP hollow sections. We cut them to the length you need on band saws, and emboss bar sections on request.

sr.sum: Flah, ugaonik, U i I profil, kvadratni pun — sečeni na dužinu koju tražite.
desc: Standardni čelični profili: flah, ugaonici, U i I profili i puni kvadratni profili. Trakastim testerama ih sečemo na dužinu koju tražite — pa ne plaćate ostatak šipke koji vam ne treba; flah i kvadrat po potrebi grifujemo.
specs: flah, ugaonik, U, I, kvadratni pun

en.sum: Flat bar, angle, channel, I-beam and solid square bar — cut to the length you need.
desc: Standard steel sections: flat bar, angles, channels, I-sections and solid square bar. We cut them on band saws to the length you ask for — so you do not pay for the rest of the bar you do not need; flat and square bar can be embossed on request.
specs: flat bar, angle, channel, I-beam, solid square

sr.sum: Električni i ručni alat vodećih brendova, oprema za varenje Varstroj i kompletna šrafovska roba.
desc: Ideja je da limar i bravar u jednoj kupovini uzmu i materijal i sve što treba da se on ugradi. Držimo električni i ručni alat vodećih brendova, opremu za varenje i kompletnu šrafovsku robu.

en.sum: Power and hand tools from leading brands, Varstroj welding equipment and a complete range of fasteners.
desc: The idea is that a sheet-metal worker or metal fabricator gets the material and everything needed to install it in a single purchase. We stock power and hand tools from leading brands, welding equipment and a complete range of fasteners.

sr.sum: Sečenje na CNC plazmi i makazama, gasno rezanje, slitovanje, savijanje, rundovanje, probijanje i sečenje profila.
desc: Sečenje na CNC plazmi i makazama, gasno rezanje, slitovanje i premotavanje kotura, savijanje i rundovanje, probijanje i isecanje uglova, sečenje profila na trakastim testerama.
Materijal možete kupiti u fabričkom pakovanju ili ga uzeti obrađenog — sve operacije radimo na svojim mašinama u Batajnici i Ugrinovcima.

en.sum: CNC plasma and guillotine cutting, oxy-fuel cutting, slitting, bending, plate rolling, punching and section cutting.
desc: Cutting on CNC plasma and guillotine shears, oxy-fuel cutting, slitting and recoiling of coils, bending and plate rolling, punching and corner notching, cutting sections on band saws.
You can buy material in mill packaging or have it processed — we carry out every operation on our own machines in Batajnica and Ugrinovci.

sr.sum: Limovi, trapezni i krovni limovi, oluci, cevi i ZP profili, čelični profili, kovani elementi, šrafovska roba i alat.
desc: Limovi u tablama i koturu, trapezni i krovni limovi, oluci i vertikale, šavne cevi i ZP profili, čelični profili, kovani elementi, pletiva, šrafovska roba, alat i oprema za varenje.
Šest grupa proizvoda pokriva sve što jedna radionica troši. Dimenzije i raspoloživost na lageru proverite sa prodajom.

en.sum: Sheet metal, trapezoidal and roofing sheet, gutters, tubes and hollow sections, steel sections, wrought-iron elements, fasteners and tools.
desc: Sheet metal in sheets and coils, trapezoidal and roofing sheet, gutters and downpipes, welded tubes and hollow sections, steel sections, wrought-iron elements, wire mesh, screws and fasteners, tools and welding equipment.
Six product groups cover everything a workshop uses. Check dimensions and stock availability with sales.

sr.sum: Trapezni lim, oluci i vertikale u dužini po želji, lamperija, parapetni lim, građevinska limarija, kanali, gazišta.
desc: Trapezni pokrivni lim, oluci i vertikale u dužini po želji, lamperija, parapetni lim, kompletna građevinska limarija, kanali za ventilaciju, pocinkovana gazišta.
Profilirke rade iz kotura, pa dužinu diktira vaš objekat — krov ili fasada bez poprečnih preklopa.

en.sum: Trapezoidal sheet, gutters and downpipes in any length, cladding panels, parapet sheet, building flashings, ducts, stair treads.
desc: Trapezoidal profiled roofing sheet, gutters and downpipes in any length you choose, metal cladding panels, parapet lining sheet, complete building sheet-metal work, ventilation ducts, galvanised stair treads.
The roll formers work from coil, so the length is set by your building — a roof or façade with no transverse laps.
